raw: {"approved":false,"notes":"The surface mostly maps to the user story: trending/top/new pool discovery, pool stats, OHLCV, trades, token profile, and batch prices are all present. I would not approve as-is because two primary tracking paths lose token perspective: geckoterminal_get_pool_ohlcv does not expose the API/client token selector (base, quote, or token address), so it always returns the base-token chart and can answer the wrong price history for users tracking the quote side or wanting an inverted pair; geckoterminal_get_pool_trades has the same missing token selector, so buy/sell direction and amounts are always base-token oriented and can be misleading. The preamble also says the public API is rate-limited at roughly 30 calls/minute, while the bundled OpenAPI/client docs say approximately 10 calls/minute, which is unsafe guidance for multi-call analysis. Minor hardening gaps: page, OHLCV limit, and comma-separated address batch limits are described but not enforced or clamped, so page >10, limit >1000, or >30-address batches can be sent directly."}
